# SCI-POINT Author Compatibility-Method Extract

Identity: `POINT-COMPATIBILITY-METHOD v0.1`

State: `unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval`

Compatibility target:
`POINT-FIT/ELLIPTICAL-GAUSSIAN-COMPATIBILITY@1`

No numerical method is supplied by this packet. The Stage B author shall keep
`SCI-POINT-UNAV-004` controlling the numerical fit and every fit-derived
product. It may define only the conditional contract and the required content
of a future exact method record.

The future record must bind:

1. the exact zero-background source-model equation, parameter ordering,
   amplitude meaning, invariant shape, published width convention,
   principal-axis ordering, orientation gauge/period/circularity behavior,
   parameter domain, constraints, and active-bound interpretation;
2. admitted fit rows, residual vector, scalar objective/likelihood, fit-weight
   identity/source/unit/support/normalization/lifecycle, relationship to
   stochastic covariance, missing/non-finite/zero/conflict behavior, and
   multiple-solution comparison;
3. authoritative expected source position versus algorithmic search center,
   central-search domain, peak score/weight, candidate population,
   interpolation, tie rule, initial parameters, fallback trigger/domain,
   one branch-independent source-association method covering central search,
   global fallback, restart, retry, and every other authorized branch;
   association domain/state/cause; fit-support motion; and requested/
   effective/resolved/applied/realized branch identity; and
4. constraint application, solver-independent resolution, local-minimum
   disposition, termination/convergence, retry behavior, rank,
   identifiability, sentinel resolution, failure, immutable identity, and
   compatibility-versus-successor status.

It must additionally define numerical applicability tests or typed
unavailability for `known`, `isolated`, `bright`, and
`approximately_centered`. `bright` is a compatibility-method class rather
than statistical significance; `approximately_centered` is a declared
relation among expected position, search/fit domains, parent support, and map
boundary.

The future record must classify every statement as established compatibility
behavior, scientific interpretation, representation/solver detail, historical
non-authority, or unresolved owner choice. A familiar method or a finite
optimizer result cannot substitute for this authority.
